newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes flat at 935-945 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes flat at 935-945 per dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev ended at 935-945 per dollar, flat from early morning trade but down from the midday's 920-935 levels as dollar demand again topped supply in the afternoon, dealers said.
(Dollar) demand from final clients rose slightly in the afternoon, erasing earlier gains for the lev," one dealer said.
The lev traded at 935-950 in the morning but firmed briefly by midday.
Dollar demand edged up in the afternoon, but supply was almost nonexistent due to expectations of further lev drops amid ongoing political instability, dealers said.
"Today's consolidation around 930-950 was mainly due to the low lev liquidity of large final clients, which prevented them from foreign currency buying," another dealer said.

But the lev was expected to resume its slide when large, final clients like energy importers improved their lev liquidity and reappeared bidding for dollars since dollar supply was expected to remain scarce.
President Petar Stoyanov was also expected to ask the ruling Bulgarian Socialist Party, largely composed of ex-communists, to form a government this week.
The opposition has threatened nationwide protests and a general strike if parliament voted for a new Socialist cabinet. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
